name: com.midmanstudio.dragndrop
description: Framework-agnostic drag-and-drop core: a single DragDropController state machine that a uGUI adapter or a UI Toolkit adapter feeds identically, so unrelated systems (inventory slots, the chemistry bench's reagent tray, anything else) can share one drag interaction layer without depending on each other. Zero game-specific logic, and deliberately zero .mdix dependency -- there's no static catalog to drive here, just runtime interaction state.
